analysis.reasonEn: RSI consolidating in neutral range for 3 consecutive sessions, MACD histogram continues to worsen. ADX at 32.6 indicates a clear trend forming, but price is moving within a narrow range between swing support at $0.24 and resistance at $0.26. With volatility ATR at 5.61%, a 1.3x ATR stop loss would be $0.237, and a 1.5 risk-reward ratio target would be $0.272. Entry at current $0.25 would not meet the risk-reward criteria. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
